channel.title: Customer Wars
channel.desc: At a coffee shop in N.Y. City, a conflict over a customer's conduct escalates into a chaotic fight with an employee; late at night in Warner Robins, Ga., a massive group brawl erupts after one patron allegedly takes issue with his fast-food meal; inside a hotel restaurant in Georgetown, Texas, police officers intervene when a woman encounters difficulties paying her bill; in Turkey, an ordinary errand to fill up a tank of gas takes a fiery turn.
